description: Agent-native Philippine Stock Exchange CLI — quotes, filings, and a local price history no free API serves.

novel_features.name: Local history query
novel_features.description: Query daily OHLC/value history for any ticker or the PSEi from the local store — data no free PSE API serves.

novel_features.name: Drift / relative strength
novel_features.description: Percent change over a window, absolute and versus the PSEi over the same sessions, with 52-week band position.

novel_features.name: Session state
novel_features.description: Philippine trading-calendar verdict: trading day or not, pre/post-close gate, last completed trading date.

novel_features.name: Freshness audit
novel_features.description: Per-ticker last-synced trading date versus the last completed trading day, with in-series gaps listed.

novel_features.name: Filing-deadline tracker
novel_features.description: Computed 17-Q/17-A due dates per SRC Rule 68 45/105-day windows, joined to local disclosures: filed, pending, or overdue.

novel_features.name: Breadth trend
novel_features.description: Advance/decline/unchanged and value-traded trend over time from local index snapshots.

novel_features.name: Local movers
novel_features.description: Ranked gainers and losers across the synced universe for a window, with universe size and as-of stated.
